rows.name: Simulation
rows.what: Marine dynamics, thruster delay and lag, RK4 plant, box contacts, sloped floors, payloads. Includes contact and dynamics checks against recordings from the old simulator.

rows.name: Sensors
rows.what: IMU, attitude, FOG, DVL, depth and pressure models: noise, bias, random walk, mounting offsets, scheduling.

rows.name: Session
rows.what: The whole tick: mechanisms, payloads, Bullet prop worlds, task observers and the RoboSub 2026 rules. TalosReference replays the old simulator's Talos trajectories.

rows.name: Cameras
rows.what: Intrinsics, projection and the stereo depth-noise model.

rows.name: Session cameras
rows.what: Scheduled on-demand capture, queues and seeds, on the GPU path.

rows.name: Rendering
rows.what: Offscreen EGL rendering, pool scene, assets, rendered images.

rows.name: Pack scene
rows.what: Building the drawable scene from packs: lane lines, fixtures, sloped floors.

rows.name: Datasets
rows.what: Samplers, the renderer's acceptance checks and output files for synthetic datasets.

rows.name: ROS bridge
rows.what: Field mapping, QoS, kill and arming services, cameras, records. real_pack_test drives the real Talos packs.

rows.name: Viewer
rows.what: Panels, the prior map editor, camera cards, input and themes.

rows.name: Packs and datasets (Python)
rows.what: Pack schemas and validation errors, resolving, set-course edits, dataset planning and export.
